verses.text: “Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.”

captions: 10:52 p.m. The last train home. Earbuds in.
Then: 1% battery. And everything goes quiet.
Just the rattle of the train. And your own heart.
Loud all day. So why does it feel this empty?
Surah Ar-Rahman. Quietly, on the counter.
And for the first time in days, it's quiet inside.
